How do you respond?

I don’t have real-time access to the internet or private databases, so I can’t check live facts, see your files, or verify current events.  
I can still be confidently wrong or incomplete, especially on niche, fast-changing, or highly specialized topics, and you shouldn’t treat me as a definitive authority.  
I also lack genuine understanding, emotions, and lived experience, so I can simulate empathy and reasoning but can’t actually “know” things or feel what you feel the way a human can.
